names.legendary: Old Wickerwell of the Picnic Rug

lore.common: Squeaks its wicker handle with every step, like it's complaining about the weight.
lore.uncommon: Packs sandwiches, cake and a flask so neatly that the lid still shuts.
lore.rare: Swallowed a whole week of laundry and a missing sock that had been gone for a year.
lore.epic: Tipped over at the top of the hill and sent apples, eggs and a teapot rolling into the village.
lore.legendary: Has carried the family picnic up the same hill every summer since the hill was smaller.

names.legendary: Sir Cardington, King of the Recycling

lore.common: Keeps its sticky tape wound so tightly that nobody can find the end.
lore.uncommon: Becomes the cat's castle the moment it's emptied, and the present inside is ignored.
lore.rare: Stacked itself on top of five others and wobbled every time someone sneezed.
lore.epic: Toppled from a tower of moving boxes and sent books, plates and a lamp across the new hall.
lore.legendary: Was turned into a rocket, a car, a castle and a robot by the same child in one week.

names.legendary: Old Slatwood of the Harbour

lore.common: Gives you a splinter every time you lift it without gloves.
lore.uncommon: Holds oranges in neat rows, so the market stall looks like a painting.
lore.rare: Was so heavy that it took four porters and a lot of groaning to lift.
lore.epic: Toppled off a market cart and sent a hundred melons rolling down the high street.
lore.legendary: Crossed the ocean three times on a cargo ship and still has the first port's stamp on its side.

names.legendary: Madame Clasp, Keeper of Everything

lore.common: Buries your keys at the very bottom every time you need them.
lore.uncommon: Holds tissues, mints, plasters, a hairbrush and, somehow, a spare umbrella.
lore.rare: Snapped its clasp shut so fast that it caught the end of a scarf.
lore.epic: Was tipped upside down at the bus stop and covered the pavement with lipsticks, receipts and coins.
lore.legendary: Has carried grandma's sweets through fifty years of birthdays and never run out.

names.legendary: Old Claspwell of the Saddle Room

lore.common: Pinches the skin of your tummy every time you do it up.
lore.uncommon: Shines so brightly in the morning sun that it blinds the person next to you.
lore.rare: Found a new hole in the belt that nobody had made, and held up the trousers anyway.
lore.epic: Clicked shut on every saddle in the stable in one morning, and the horses set off at once.
lore.legendary: Has held the same horse's saddle steady through a hundred races.

names.legendary: Lady Glitterclip of the Classroom

lore.common: Slides out of your hair halfway through every school day.
lore.uncommon: Has so much glitter on it that it leaves sparkles on the pillow.
lore.rare: Held back a whole fringe through a windy football match.
lore.epic: Was clipped into every head in the playground on glitter day, and the whole school sparkled.
lore.legendary: Has held back three sisters' fringes over twenty years and never lost a single sparkle.

names.legendary: Old Crinkleworth of the Lunchbox

lore.common: Tears down the side instead of the top, so everything falls out.
lore.uncommon: Leaves crumbs in the bottom that nobody can reach.
lore.rare: Shook so many seeds over the garden that it grew a whole meadow.
lore.epic: Burst open in the car and filled the back seat with a blizzard of crisps.
lore.legendary: Has crinkled in the same lunchbox every school day and never once been eaten quietly.

names.legendary: Old Pillar of the Village Green

lore.common: Jams every big envelope halfway in so you have to push it with your elbow.
lore.uncommon: Stands on the corner in bright red, so nobody can ever say they couldn't find it.
lore.rare: Swallowed a whole parcel that should never have fitted through the slot.
lore.epic: Filled to the top with birthday cards in one day, and the postman needed a wheelbarrow.
lore.legendary: Has stood on the same village corner for a hundred years and posted every love letter in the village.

names.legendary: Sir Musksworth of the Bathroom Shelf

lore.common: Sprays so hard that the whole bathroom smells of pine for a week.
lore.uncommon: Is splashed on the neck every morning by someone who thinks it's very grown-up.
lore.rare: Was sniffed by the cat, which sneezed and refused to come into the bathroom for a day.
lore.epic: Was sprayed by every uncle at the wedding, and the cake tasted of pine.
lore.legendary: Has been splashed on before every important day for forty years, and the bottle is still half full.

names.legendary: Madame Parfum of the Dressing Table

lore.common: Puffs so much scent that everyone in the lift starts coughing.
lore.uncommon: Smells of a whole garden of roses packed into one tiny bottle.
lore.rare: Has a crystal stopper that sparkles like a little chandelier on the dressing table.
lore.epic: Was sprayed at everyone walking through the department store, and the whole street smelled of roses.
lore.legendary: Has sat on the same dressing table for sixty years and still smells exactly like grandma.

names.legendary: Captain Trolley of Terminal Three

lore.common: Has one wheel that wobbles and drags you sideways through the airport.
lore.uncommon: Bulges so much that someone has to sit on it to close the zip.
lore.rare: Went round the airport carousel so many times that it got dizzy.
lore.epic: Burst open on the airport carousel and sent a hundred socks round in a circle.
lore.legendary: Has travelled to fifty countries and still has the luggage tag from its very first trip.

names.legendary: Old Goldbeard's Iron-Bound Chest

lore.common: Slams its lid on your fingers every time you peek inside.
lore.uncommon: Keeps every coin, button and shiny pebble the children ever found.
lore.rare: Had a lock so stubborn that even the key gave up.
lore.epic: Was dug up on the beach and spilled so many toys that the sandcastles were forgotten.
lore.legendary: Sat at the bottom of the sea for three hundred years and came up still holding every coin.

names.legendary: Old Leatherby of the Back Pocket

lore.common: Spills coins all over the floor whenever you open it.
lore.uncommon: Is stuffed so full of old receipts that it won't shut.
lore.rare: Disappeared into a pocket that wasn't there yesterday, and turned up in the fridge.
lore.epic: Dropped open at the busy till and sent cards, coins and a library ticket in every direction.
lore.legendary: Has been sat on in the same back pocket for thirty years and is now exactly bottom-shaped.

names.legendary: Lady Tinkleton of the Shore

lore.common: Tinkles with every step, so you can never sneak to the fridge.
lore.uncommon: Gets wrapped in seaweed every time you paddle at the beach.
lore.rare: Sparkled so brightly in the shallow water that the fish followed it.
lore.epic: Jingled through the beach dance on every ankle at once, and the waves kept time.
lore.legendary: Has been worn on every beach holiday for twenty years and still jingles the same tune.

names.legendary: Old Stripeshade of the High Street

lore.common: Drips rainwater down the back of your neck as you walk past.
lore.uncommon: Throws a stripy shade over the café tables on the sunniest day.
lore.rare: Got its crank stuck halfway, so it sagged like a sleepy eyelid.
lore.epic: Caught a whole summer storm in its canvas, then dumped it all on the café at once.
lore.legendary: Has shaded the same bakery window for eighty years and kept every cake perfectly cool.

names.legendary: The Great Box of Choosing

lore.common: Swallows paper slips and won't tell anyone what's written on them.
lore.uncommon: Is used by the class to vote on what to name the new hamster.
lore.rare: Kept everyone guessing until the very last slip was counted.
lore.epic: Held so many votes for the school's new playground that the teacher counted until bedtime.
lore.legendary: Chose the name of every class pet for thirty years, and not one hamster complained.

names.legendary: Captain Parasolio of the Promenade

lore.common: Wobbles in the sand so that it falls on whoever is sleeping underneath.
lore.uncommon: Throws shade over exactly one person, and everyone else squeezes in.
lore.rare: Blew out of the sand in a gust and cartwheeled down the beach.
lore.epic: Tumbled along the whole beach in a gale, knocking over every deckchair on the way.
lore.legendary: Has shaded the same family on the same beach every summer for thirty years.

names.legendary: Grand Abacus of the Craft Table

lore.common: Rolls under the sofa the moment it falls off the table.
lore.uncommon: Slips off the end of the string just as the necklace is nearly finished.
lore.rare: Was counted into a rainbow pattern so perfectly that nobody wanted to wear it.
lore.epic: Spilled out of the jar with a thousand others, and the whole kitchen floor became a marble run.
lore.legendary: Was threaded into a necklace so long that it went round the whole school hall.

names.legendary: Old Zipwell of the Mountain Path

lore.common: Bumps against your hip with every step, all day long.
lore.uncommon: Has a little zip pocket where snacks disappear forever.
lore.rare: Kept a map, a compass and a sandwich safe through a whole mountain hike.
lore.epic: Was worn by everyone at the festival, and the crowd moved like one big zip.
lore.legendary: Has been on every family hike for twenty years and still has a raisin from the first one.

names.legendary: Lady Obento of the Picnic Blanket

lore.common: Lets its rice tip into the fruit section if you carry it sideways.
lore.uncommon: Has a little box for everything, and nothing is allowed to touch.
lore.rare: Was arranged so beautifully that nobody wanted to eat it.
lore.epic: Started a lunch swap that went all the way round the school canteen.
lore.legendary: Has packed a hundred perfect lunches for the same family and never mixed a single compartment.

names.legendary: Lady Bangleworth of the Market

lore.common: Jangles against the desk every time you write a word.
lore.uncommon: Clinks against your cup every time you drink.
lore.rare: Caught on every jumper sleeve so firmly that it unravelled a cardigan.
lore.epic: Jangled on every wrist at the summer fête, and the band couldn't hear itself.
lore.legendary: Has been passed from grandmother to granddaughter for a hundred years and still jangles the same.

names.legendary: Lady Cameo of the Velvet Lapel

lore.common: Pokes its pin into your finger every time you try to fasten it.
lore.uncommon: Gleams on the lapel so brightly that everyone asks where it came from.
lore.rare: Held a scarf in place through a gale on the clifftop.
lore.epic: Glittered on every coat at the grand ball, and the chandelier felt plain.
lore.legendary: Has been pinned to the same grandma's coat for sixty years and has never come undone.

names.legendary: Old Pouchworth of the Holiday Coach

lore.common: Ends up on the front when it's meant to be at the back.
lore.uncommon: Clunks its zip against everything when you bend over.
lore.rare: Kept a tourist's passport, tickets and suncream safe through a whole holiday.
lore.epic: Was worn by every tourist at the theme park, and the queues looked like a parade of pouches.
lore.legendary: Has been on fifty package holidays and still has the first sun cream bottle inside.

names.legendary: Old Buttonwell of the Tin

lore.common: Pops off your shirt at the worst possible moment.
lore.uncommon: Always ends up in the wrong hole, so your coat hangs crooked.
lore.rare: Shone so brightly on the soldier's coat that the general noticed it from across the field.
lore.epic: Spilled from the sewing tin with a thousand others, and the floor was covered for a week.
lore.legendary: Has been sewn onto five coats over a hundred years and still has all four holes.

names.legendary: Old Shutterworth of the Safari

lore.common: Digs its strap into your shoulder after an hour of walking.
lore.uncommon: Guards every lens like a squashy little bodyguard.
lore.rare: Has a pocket for every battery, card and lens cap, and you still can't find the right one.
lore.epic: Carried every camera on the safari trip through dust and rain without a single scratch.
lore.legendary: Has been on a hundred photo trips around the world and still smells faintly of the first jungle.

names.legendary: Old Tillsworth of the Village Fete

lore.common: Rattles so loudly when you carry it that everyone knows there's money inside.
lore.uncommon: Has a tiny key that is always lost.
lore.rare: Counted the money at the jumble sale so neatly that the club treasurer asked it to do her sums.
lore.epic: Took so many coins at the village fête that its lid wouldn't shut.
lore.legendary: Has looked after the money at every village fête for fifty years and never been a penny short.

names.legendary: Captain Crunchwell of the Kitchen

lore.common: Hides the last crumbs in the bottom corner where no spoon can reach.
lore.uncommon: Has a toy inside that every child digs for before breakfast.
lore.rare: Ripped its inner bag so the cereal went everywhere.
lore.epic: Was poured so fast at breakfast that the bowl overflowed onto the table, the floor and the dog.
lore.legendary: Has been on the breakfast table every morning for ten years and is still somehow full.

names.legendary: Lady Charmsworth of the Jewellery Box

lore.common: Clatters so loudly that you can hear it from the next room.
lore.uncommon: Has a charm for every holiday its owner ever went on.
lore.rare: Brought so much luck on exam day that its owner passed every test.
lore.epic: Started a charm swap at the party, and every bracelet came home with a new charm.
lore.legendary: Has a charm for every birthday from one to ninety, and still has room for more.

names.legendary: Old Cedarlid of the Toy Cupboard

lore.common: Creaks its lid open so slowly that you think it's haunted.
lore.uncommon: Is now used to keep crayons, string and a broken watch.
lore.rare: Hid a whole collection of marbles so well that nobody found it for years.
lore.epic: Was found in the attic full of old photographs, and the whole family spent the day looking at them.
lore.legendary: Has kept the same family's tiny treasures for a hundred years, from conkers to wedding rings.

names.legendary: Madame Clutchella of the Opera

lore.common: Gets squeezed under your arm so tightly that it slips out at the worst moment.
lore.uncommon: Snaps shut with a satisfying click every time.
lore.rare: Holds only a lipstick and a key, and refuses to hold anything else.
lore.epic: Glittered at the gala night so brightly that the photographers kept snapping it.
lore.legendary: Has been to every opera night in the city for thirty years and never once been left on a seat.

names.legendary: Little Parasolina of the Lemonade

lore.common: Perches on your glass and pokes you in the nose with every sip.
lore.uncommon: Pops open and shut so many times that the paper tears.
lore.rare: Stabbed through a cherry, a pineapple chunk and a lemon slice all at once.
lore.epic: Was popped into every drink at the pool party, and the poolside looked like a tiny beach.
lore.legendary: Has shaded the ice cubes in a thousand lemonades and never once let one melt too quickly.

names.legendary: Old Goldpiece of the Fountain

lore.common: Slips down the back of the sofa and lives there with the crumbs.
lore.uncommon: Is flipped to decide every argument and always lands on the edge.
lore.rare: Was thrown into the fountain and granted a wish, or so its owner says.
lore.epic: Was thrown into the wishing well with a thousand others, and the well overflowed with silver.
lore.legendary: Has passed through ten thousand hands and still has the old king's face on it.

names.legendary: Granny Kisslock's Bottomless Purse

lore.common: Snaps its little kiss-clasp shut on your fingertip every time.
lore.uncommon: Hoards so many pennies that it weighs more than the shopping.
lore.rare: Pinched the last coin back out of the shopkeeper's hand before he could take it.
lore.epic: Jingled through the whole market on a Saturday, and every stall knew it was coming.
lore.legendary: Has paid for ice creams for four generations of grandchildren and has never once been empty.

names.legendary: The Great Piggy Bank Hoard

lore.common: Jingles in your pocket all day so everyone hears you coming.
lore.uncommon: Stacks itself into a tower that falls over the moment someone breathes.
lore.rare: Fed the arcade machine all afternoon and won a single plastic ring.
lore.epic: Poured out of the broken piggy bank in a waterfall that rolled under every bit of furniture.
lore.legendary: Was saved one at a time for ten years and finally bought a whole bicycle.

names.legendary: Lady Reflecta of the Handbag

lore.common: Claps shut on your nose just as you're checking your face.
lore.uncommon: Flashes sunlight into the eyes of everyone on the bus.
lore.rare: Puffed a cloud of face powder over the whole dressing table.
lore.epic: Signalled across the whole valley by flashing sunlight, and the hikers waved back.
lore.legendary: Was used to signal a rescue helicopter from a mountain top, and has been treasured ever since.

names.legendary: Captain Chillworth of the Car Boot

lore.common: Has a latch so stiff that the picnic waits while everyone wrestles it.
lore.uncommon: Keeps the yoghurts cold on the hottest beach day.
lore.rare: Took up the whole car boot, so the luggage had to go on the roof.
lore.epic: Kept a beach picnic for twenty people cold through the hottest afternoon of the year.
lore.legendary: Has been to every family picnic for twenty years and still has the first frozen ice pack.

names.legendary: Old Frostbox of the Campsite

lore.common: Has a squeaky wheel that squeals across the whole campsite.
lore.uncommon: Hauls a mountain of drinks and still has room for the ice.
lore.rare: Doubled as a seat at the football match and kept the sitter's bottom very cool.
lore.epic: Kept the drinks cold at the campsite party for a whole weekend, and everyone came back for more.
lore.legendary: Has been dragged to every camping trip for twenty-five years and still has its original wheels.

names.legendary: Sir Linksworth, Last of the Pair

lore.common: Loses its partner on every big occasion, so one sleeve flaps.
lore.uncommon: Holds a shirt cuff closed with a tiny twist and a click.
lore.rare: Sparkled so brightly on the groom's wrist that the photographer had to dim the lights.
lore.epic: Glittered on every wrist at the grand wedding, and the dance floor twinkled.
lore.legendary: Has been to fifty weddings on the same wrist and never once come undone.

names.legendary: The Twin Gold Cuffs of the Dinner Jacket

lore.common: Hides in the drawer until the very last minute before the party.
lore.uncommon: Always comes as a perfect matching pair, and gets upset if split.
lore.rare: Was engraved with its owner's initials, so everyone knows whose they are.
lore.epic: Dazzled at the black-tie dinner so much that every guest checked their own cuffs.
lore.legendary: Has been handed from father to son for a hundred years and still sparkles at every wedding.

names.legendary: Sir Parcelworth of the Front Porch

lore.common: Arrives while you're in the shower and waits on the doorstep in the rain.
lore.uncommon: Is wrapped in so much tape that you need scissors, a knife and patience.
lore.rare: Went to the wrong house three times and came back with a new address label each time.
lore.epic: Piled up on the doorstep with every parcel in the street before the holidays.
lore.legendary: Travelled round the whole world by mistake and still arrived on the right birthday.

names.legendary: Captain Readyall of the Nursery

lore.common: Always has every wipe in the world except the one you need.
lore.uncommon: Unfolds into a changing mat on any bench in the park.
lore.rare: Held nappies, bottles, toys, spare socks and a whole picnic in one shoulder bag.
lore.epic: Kept a whole playgroup of babies changed, fed and happy on the zoo trip.
lore.legendary: Has been carried by three generations of parents and still has a dummy in the side pocket.

names.legendary: Old Givewell of the Shop Counter

lore.common: Rattles at you from the shop counter until you drop in your change.
lore.uncommon: Is shaken by volunteers outside the supermarket every Saturday.
lore.rare: Collected so many coins that it had to be emptied twice in one day.
lore.epic: Was filled by the whole town at the summer fun run, and the hospital got a new playroom.
lore.legendary: Has collected coins on the same counter for forty years and helped build a whole children's ward.

names.legendary: Old Sailor's Kitbag of the Seven Ports

lore.common: Keeps everything at the very bottom, so you have to tip it out to find anything.
lore.uncommon: Is shaped like a big sausage, so it rolls off the car seat.
lore.rare: Was dragged across the whole station platform because nobody could lift it.
lore.epic: Carried every bit of kit for the whole sports camp and still had room for a tent.
lore.legendary: Sailed round the world on a sailor's shoulder and still smells faintly of the sea.

names.legendary: Lady Pearldrop of the Opera House

lore.common: Pinches your ear lobe all evening and you can't stop fiddling with it.
lore.uncommon: Always loses its little back, so it falls out when you hug someone.
lore.rare: Fell down the bathroom sink and was rescued with a coat hanger.
lore.epic: Dangled and swung through every dance at the party, and caught every disco light.
lore.legendary: Has been worn at every opera night for sixty years and still has its original pearl.

names.legendary: Sir Eggsworth of the Fridge Door

lore.common: Always has one cracked egg hiding in the corner.
lore.uncommon: Holds exactly twelve eggs in perfect little cups.
lore.rare: Was turned into a crocodile, a caterpillar and a pirate ship in one art lesson.
lore.epic: Slipped off the shopping trolley, and the supermarket floor became an omelette.
lore.legendary: Carried a dozen eggs from the farm to the market on a bumpy cart without cracking one.

names.legendary: Madame Kohlette of the Dressing Room

lore.common: Wobbles on every line, so one eye always looks different.
lore.uncommon: Smudges the moment you blink, so you look very tired.
lore.rare: Flicked a wing so sharp at the corner of the eye that it could cut paper.
lore.epic: Drew the eyes of every actor in the play before curtain-up, and nobody smudged.
lore.legendary: Has drawn a thousand perfect lines for the same ballet dancer and never once wobbled.

names.legendary: Old Clipwell of the Running Track

lore.common: Clips round your waist and pinches the skin when it closes.
lore.uncommon: Stashes enough snacks for a whole day out.
lore.rare: Jammed its clip on the roller coaster, and its owner rode it three times.
lore.epic: Was clipped round every runner in the marathon, and the water stations ran out of cups.
lore.legendary: Has run a hundred marathons on the same waist and still has the same energy bar inside.

names.legendary: Old Tophat, Winner of Many Games

lore.common: Hops onto the wrong square when nobody is looking.
lore.uncommon: Tumbles off the board every time someone bumps the table.
lore.rare: Raced round the board so fast that it landed on every bonus square.
lore.epic: Won a board game that lasted all weekend, and the whole family needed a holiday.
lore.legendary: Has won every family game night for twenty years, and nobody will play it any more.

names.legendary: Lady Giftwell of the Birthday Table

lore.common: Has so much tissue paper inside that the present gets lost.
lore.uncommon: Snaps its handles the moment you put something heavy in it.
lore.rare: Has been given at five different birthdays and still has the first card stuck inside.
lore.epic: Was handed out at the birthday party filled with sweets, and every child went home buzzing.
lore.legendary: Has carried presents to a hundred birthdays and never once torn its handles.

names.legendary: The Great Unwrapping

lore.common: Ties its ribbon in a knot so tight that you have to wait ages to open it.
lore.uncommon: Is shaken by everyone trying to guess what's inside.
lore.rare: Surprised its owner so much that they screamed and dropped the cake.
lore.epic: Piled up under the party table with fifty others until the presents touched the ceiling.
lore.legendary: Held the best birthday present ever, and the paper is still kept in a drawer.

names.legendary: Old Wideshade of the Golf Course

lore.common: Gets wedged in every doorway because it's too wide to fit through.
lore.uncommon: Is so big that it keeps four people dry at once.
lore.rare: Poked its pointy end into a puddle and splashed the whole queue.
lore.epic: Kept the whole golf tournament dry in a sudden downpour.
lore.legendary: Has kept the same golfer dry through forty years of rainy rounds.

names.legendary: Old Shopsworth of the Kitchen Cupboard

lore.common: Cuts into your fingers with its handles when it's full.
lore.uncommon: Splits at the bottom just as you reach the front door.
lore.rare: Has been used for every food shop for ten years and still hasn't ripped.
lore.epic: Carried the whole week's shopping in one trip, and the eggs survived.
lore.legendary: Has carried a thousand food shops home and now lives in the cupboard with its hundred friends.

names.legendary: Coach Kitbag of the School Gym

lore.common: Smells so bad of old socks that everyone moves away on the bus.
lore.uncommon: Has a special pocket for trainers that smell even worse.
lore.rare: Kept a whole kit, a towel and a banana safe for a week.
lore.epic: Opened in the changing room, and every child held their nose at once.
lore.legendary: Has carried the same school kit for five years and still hasn't been washed.

names.legendary: Old Frostlid of the Harbour

lore.common: Drips melted ice all over the car floor on the way home.
lore.uncommon: Keeps the fish cold all day on the fishing boat.
lore.rare: Held a block of ice so big that it lasted a whole week.
lore.epic: Kept the whole fishing club's catch fresh on the longest trip of the year.
lore.legendary: Has been on every fishing trip for thirty years and still smells faintly of mackerel.

names.legendary: Lady Velvetlid of the Dressing Table

lore.common: Plays the same tinkly tune every time you open it, even at midnight.
lore.uncommon: Has a tiny ballerina that spins round when the lid opens.
lore.rare: Tangled every necklace inside into one big knot.
lore.epic: Played its tune so long that the whole house fell asleep.
lore.legendary: Has kept the same family's jewels safe for a hundred years and still plays its tune perfectly.

names.legendary: Old Treasurebox of the Wardrobe

lore.common: Gets opened every time someone feels like a little cry.
lore.uncommon: Hoards cinema tickets, birthday cards and baby teeth.
lore.rare: Held a photo so old that nobody can remember who is in it.
lore.epic: Spilled across the floor during a house move, and the whole family stopped to look at every memory.
lore.legendary: Has kept the same family's memories for a hundred years and never lost a single photo.

names.legendary: Sir Briefsworth of the Morning Train

lore.common: Forgets the charger every single time.
lore.uncommon: Has a padded pocket that the laptop never quite fits in.
lore.rare: Slipped off the shoulder on the train and clonked a commuter on the head.
lore.epic: Was squashed on the rush hour train with a hundred others and still came out in one piece.
lore.legendary: Has carried the same laptop to the same office for ten years and still has its first coffee stain.

names.legendary: Lady Balmsworth of the Coat Pocket

lore.common: Drops its cap every time you use it, and the cap rolls away.
lore.uncommon: Melts in your pocket on warm days.
lore.rare: Smeared so much cherry flavour that the dog licked its owner's face.
lore.epic: Rescued every chapped lip on the school ski trip.
lore.legendary: Has lived in the same coat pocket for ten winters and still has a little left.

names.legendary: Madame Rouge of the Dressing Room

lore.common: Ends up on your teeth instead of your lips.
lore.uncommon: Leaves a kiss mark on every cup you drink from.
lore.rare: Twisted up so far that it snapped off and rolled under the bed.
lore.epic: Was worn by every guest at the red carpet party, and the cameras flashed all night.
lore.legendary: Has been worn by the same opera singer for every performance for thirty years.

names.legendary: The Silver Heart of the Great Aunt

lore.common: Has a clasp so tiny that it takes ten minutes to close.
lore.uncommon: Holds a tiny photo inside that nobody else is allowed to see.
lore.rare: Kept a secret so well that the family didn't know what was inside for fifty years.
lore.epic: Was opened at the family party, and everyone gasped at the photo inside.
lore.legendary: Has been passed down through seven generations and still has the same tiny photo.

names.legendary: Old Lunchsack of the Classroom Peg

lore.common: Squashes the sandwich every time it's dropped in the playground.
lore.uncommon: Has a silver lining that keeps the yoghurt cold.
lore.rare: Kept a packed lunch safe from a hungry seagull on the beach trip.
lore.epic: Was raided by the whole class at lunchtime when the crisps came out.
lore.legendary: Has hung on the same classroom peg for five years and never lost a lunch.

names.legendary: Captain Lunchington of the Playground

lore.common: Snaps its clips so hard that the sandwich jumps.
lore.uncommon: Spills juice into the sandwich every single day.
lore.rare: Traded its biscuit for the best crisps in the class.
lore.epic: Fell open on the coach trip and rolled an apple, a yoghurt and a sandwich down the whole aisle.
lore.legendary: Has been to every school day for six years and still has its first sticker.

names.legendary: Madame Glamourpouch of the Theatre

lore.common: Gets powder everywhere inside, so everything comes out dusty.
lore.uncommon: Is stuffed with so many brushes that the zip won't close.
lore.rare: Burst its zip open in the handbag and coloured the whole inside pink.
lore.epic: Spilled across the theatre dressing room just before curtain-up, and every actor helped pick up.
lore.legendary: Has done the makeup for a hundred shows and never once lost a brush.
